elements_selected.content: Implement theory caching per ADR-006 and NFR-011. Cache the parsed theory (not conclusions — re-reason each time per Open Question 4) to .zetl/theory.json alongside the existing index.json. Use the same mtime-based invalidation: if any file containing an SPL block has changed, invalidate and rebuild. Track which files contain SPL blocks for targeted invalidation. Cache format: serialized Theory with provenance metadata. Subsequent reason queries should load cache + re-reason (~100ms) instead of full extract + parse + reason (~2-3s for large vaults).
